A name to watch for the future is Rhian Letang. She scored good points in the throws but has two more years in the age group being just 12 years old.

We had several winners in the youngest age-group but a special mention must be made of new member Natalie Laws who won the 200m, that tough middle-distance runner Janine Brown and our mighty throwers Tigho Ejoh and Rhian Letang.
Winner in match one over 800 metres, Janine Brown found herself beaten here even though she set a faster time, but she made up for it by joining with Rhian Letang to record two firsts in the javelin.

A whole succession of under-15 2nd places came our way thanks to Gemma Watson in the sprints, Janine and Debbie Hearn in the 800 metres and Rhian Letang in the throws but the best performance of the day came in the oldest age-group where Ray James pulled Win Shepherd around the track in record time in the chariot race!
